paragraphs: Mentioned in Megillah 4a; in Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 2:4; in Moed Katan 26a; and at the end of Vayikra Rabbah chapter 11: R. Chelbo said, Ulla Biraah said, R. Elazar said. In Vayikra Rabbah 13:2 he spoke in the name of R. Shimon bar Yochai.

notes.text: Chelbo reports Ulla, who reports Elazar. The final Shimon bar Yochai attribution is a separate cited occurrence.

The Bavli’s Megillah passage names Chelbo and Ulla. The Yerushalmi has a longer chain with Rabbi Lazar and Rabbi Chanina. Moed Katan explicitly gives Chelbo, Ulla and Elazar in sequence. The consulted Vayikra Rabbah 13:2 spells out Rabbi Shimon ben Yochai, while Hyman supplies the acronym רש״בי. The report about the end of chapter 11 awaits collation.
